title: Order
heading: Order from {company}
description: Choose the parts you need and confirm. {company} receives the order and you get the confirmation on WhatsApp.
selected: {count, plural, =0 {No parts chosen} one {# part chosen} other {# parts chosen}}

confirmed.title: Order sent
confirmed.description: {company} received your order. The confirmation is in your WhatsApp chat.

cancelled.title: Order cancelled
cancelled.description: Nothing was sent to {company}. Search again on WhatsApp to order.

unavailable.title: This link is no longer valid
unavailable.description: It has expired or the search is no longer available. Search again on WhatsApp to get a new link.

decline.title: Close without ordering?
decline.description: The link closes and nothing is sent to {company}. To order later, search again on WhatsApp.
